findings_qualitative.value: HCN/HNC in inner ring set by ice sublimation after burst plus HNC conversion by H and O; outer ring ratio unchanged by burst

evidence.quote: The ice abundance ratio between HCN and HNC is intrinsically large, resulting in a high abundance ratio in gas after sublimation.

claims.hypothesis: Chemical model with low barrier energies reproduces observed ratios in both rings
claims.experiment: One-point chemistry for both rings with burst
claims.result: High ratio in inner ring, ~2 in outer ring
claims.finding: Ratios reproduced; inner ring ratio from ice sublimation and conversion reactions

evidence.quote: the HCN/HNC abundance ratio during the burst is highly elevated, consistent with the observed ratio in the inner ring.

claims.hypothesis: Theoretical high barrier energies are consistent with non-detection of HNC in inner ring
claims.result: Gas HNC ~2e-12 vs ~1e-15, so HNC should be detectable
claims.finding: Barrier energies must be lower than theoretical values

evidence.loc: 5.1 Effect of barrier energies in reactions
evidence.quote: The absence of HNC emission in the inner ring indicates that the barrier energies must be considerably lower than the theoretical values

claims.hypothesis: UV and CR affect the ratio
claims.finding: Ratio less sensitive to UV and CR than to density or temperature

evidence.quote: The abundance ratios are likely less sensitive to the UV radiation strength and the cosmic ray ionization rate than density or temperature.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: High (KIDA) barrier energies rejected because they predict detectable HNC in the inner ring

evidence.loc: 5.1 Effect of barrier energies in reactions
evidence.quote: the HNC line emission should be detected, which is not in accordance with our observational results

limitations_admitted.value: Simple one-point model; no 2D ring structure or absolute column densities; lines may be optically thick

evidence.quote: We do not intend to reproduce the 2D ring structures observed in the HCN and HNC emission or the absolute column densities of the molecules.

referee_caveats_inferred: Observed ratio rests on a single-point isotopologue intensity ratio with assumed equal fractionation
Midplane assumption for HCN emission is weakly justified
Temperatures from brightness of possibly non-thermalised lines
Only fiducial barrier pair tested at low values; no fit or parameter uncertainty
